Package com.google.genai.gaos.models.errors

Class ContinuationInterruptedException

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Throwable
java.lang.Exception
java.lang.RuntimeException
com.google.genai.gaos.models.errors.ContinuationInterruptedException
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class ContinuationInterruptedException extends RuntimeException
Thrown when Interactions automatic continuation fails after progress.

interactions.create() with automatic continuation enabled (the default) may make several requests ("hops"), each one resuming the decode from the previous hop's continuation_token. If a hop fails after the server already produced (and billed) output in an earlier hop, or after a resumable checkpoint was reached, this exception is thrown instead of the underlying error so the work is not lost. The underlying error is Throwable.getCause().

To resume, pass continuationToken() as continuation_token to interactions.create(): with store enabled (the default), also pass interactionId() as previous_interaction_id and no input; with store=false, resend the original input.
